About Us: Zensurance is redefining commercial insurance for Canadian businesses. As a leading InsurTech, we make getting the right coverage simple, fast, and accessible through a digital-first experience. Our platform combines advanced technology with deep industry expertise to deliver tailored insurance solutions that help businesses thrive.

Zensurance has been recognized for its rapid growth and industry impact: ✅ Deloitte’s Technology Fast 50 (2023, 2024, 2025) ✅ Deloitte’s Technology Fast 500 (2024, 2025) ✅ Top Insurance Employers (2022) At Zensurance , we value ownership, collaboration, and innovation.

Our team thrives on solving complex challenges, challenging the status quo, and making a real impact in an industry ready for change. If you're looking to build something meaningful in a fast-growing, customer-focused company, we’d love to hear from you!

We’re hiring a Staff Product Manager to help shape the future of our products and drive company-wide impact! This is a senior-level, subject-matter-expert role that combines strategic vision with hands-on leadership across multiple teams.

The Product team works to design, develop, and manage user-centered digital products that align with our business goals. Through close collaboration with stakeholders, user feedback, and data-driven insights, we deliver innovative and reliable solutions that move the business forward.

Reporting to the Director of Product, you’ll define and deliver a 2–3 year product strategy that aligns with the company’s long-term vision. You’ll work closely with Product and Engineering leadership to shape development practices, influence roadmaps, and ensure consistent product direction across teams.

As an individual contributor and domain expert, you’ll raise the bar for Product Management through mentorship, technical depth, and scalable processes that promote fact-based problem solving and continuous improvement. This is a remote-first role within the GTA.

Responsibilities: Act as a strategic thought leader, creating clear and inspiring narratives that align teams and stakeholders around a shared product vision.

Define, own, and gain buy-in for the 2-3 year product vision of the assigned domain, and develop a concrete 18-24 month strategy and roadmap that ensures alignment with the overall product and business strategy. Collaborate with Product leaders to co-develop and optimize the overarching 18-24 month product strategy and roadmap.

Partner with Product leadership to shape cross-domain priorities, coordinate resources, and maintain alignment across multiple teams. Serve as the strategic hub and arbiter for product and development teams, resolving significant dependencies and conflicting priorities to drive successful delivery.

Lead end-to-end problem solving from strategy to execution, balancing business and technical needs to maximize impact and ROI. Proactively identify high-value opportunities, assess risks, and align stakeholders on the best path forward.

Collaborate with Engineering leadership to ensure the future state of the product and technical strategy aligns with long-term goals. Establish and share best practices that strengthen strategic planning and execution across the Product team.

Partner with Product and Engineering leaders to raise the organization’s overall strategic and delivery capabilities. Mentor Product Managers on advanced discovery, stakeholder alignment, and strategic execution.

Requirements: University degree or college diploma in a recognized technical, vocational or academic program (preferably in Engineering or Computer Science) or equivalent work 10+ years of experience in digital or software Product Management. 5+ years of experience as a senior individual contributor or an equivalent role in Product Management, with proven hands-on experience leading and implementing company-wide strategic initiatives across multiple product domains and teams.

Proven success owning the full product lifecycle, from 0 to 1 through scale, ideally in a complex, customer-facing platform or self-serve digital product. Strong ability to dive into technical architecture, understand complex data flows, and make informed decisions about platform, infrastructure, and APIs.

Skilled in building and executing product strategy and long-term roadmaps that tie to business outcomes. Deep understanding of strategic frameworks, linking day-to-day execution with long-term company value. Advanced experience in feature planning, resource management, and prioritization across multiple teams.

Proven track record of improving and scaling product processes in collaboration with product leadership. Strong discovery skills, consistently identifying the right problems, validating with data, and applying structured frameworks.

What You Bring: A thoughtful, data-driven approach to decision making and the confidence to prioritize what matters most. A genuine passion for developing the product craft and problem-solving skills of other product managers. Clear and persuasive communication skills, especially when working with executives and cross-functional teams.

You can work independently, navigate ambiguity with ease, and deliver results. Strategic thinking with a systems mindset, anticipating how today’s decisions shape tomorrow’s outcomes. A collaborative and growth-oriented mindset with a passion for mentoring and elevating other Product Managers.

Benefits & Perks at Zensurance : At Zensurance , we know that when our people thrive, so does our business. That’s why we offer a flexible, people-first work environment designed to support your well-being, growth, and success. 💻 Work Your Way
· Remote-first setup for added flexibility
· Home office allowance to create a comfortable workspace
· Top-tier tech: "Office in a box" with all necessary tech equipment
· Half days before public holidays: Enjoy half days before long weekends ❤️ Your Health, Your Way
· Flexible health and dental plans for families, including mental health support
· Health & personal spending accounts to invest in wellness your way
· Parental leave top-up, because family comes first 🚀 Investing in Your Growth
· Education assistance reimbursement for courses, conferences, books, and memberships
· Opportunities to learn from industry experts and grow your career 🤝 Staying Connected
· Weekly Friday huddles to share updates and connect across teams
· Virtual & in-person team-building events to strengthen our culture We’re building something special. Come be a part of it! Who We Are: Business is hard work, but insurance doesn’t have to be! We empower business owners with simple, tech-driven insurance solutions through our online platform. Our success is fueled by our team-oriented culture and four core values: DELIVER – We set ambitious goals and achieve them. INCLUDE – We foster an open and safe space for all. INTEGRITY – We do what’s right. INVENT – We create straightforward, innovative solutions. AI Tools and Your Interview: We know AI is a valuable tool, and you're welcome to use it to prepare for your interview. However, please don't use AI assistants during the live interview itself. We want to have an authentic conversation with you, and using AI during the interview could affect our evaluation of your suitability for the role. Just so you know, we use an AI scribe to help us take notes and review interviews, ensuring a fair and clear process. Diversity & Inclusion: Zensurance celebrates diversity and is committed to creating an inclusive environment. We welcome applications from all backgrounds and provide accommodations throughout the hiring process. If you need support, let us know, we’re here to help. Thank You! We review every application with care to find the best fit for our team. While we may take a little time to get back to you due to the high volume of applications we receive, know that a real human (not a bot!) is reviewing yours. We appreciate your patience and can't wait to learn more about you! Originally posted on Himalayas

About You You are an AI Technical Product Manager who is passionate about building AI-powered products that solve real business problems and deliver measurable value. You thrive at the intersection of business, technology, and artificial intelligence, translating strategic objectives into scalable product solutions.

You enjoy working with cross-functional teams, defining product vision, prioritizing initiatives, and driving AI adoption across the organization. You are analytical, customer-focused, and comfortable balancing business needs, technical feasibility, and user experience to maximize the impact of AI investments.

You Bring to Applaudo the Following Competencies: Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Systems, Business, Engineering, Artificial Intelligence, or a related field is desired, or equivalent professional experience. 5+ years of experience as a Product Manager or Product Owner. 3+ years of experience managing enterprise software products and product roadmaps.

Proven experience defining product vision, strategy, roadmaps, and managing product backlogs. Strong understanding of Machine Learning fundamentals. Hands-on experience with Generative AI, Large Language Models (LLMs), AI Agents, and Prompt Engineering.

Experience with Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), Semantic Search, and Enterprise Knowledge Bases. Experience defining KPIs, measuring product performance, and driving user adoption. Ability to translate business requirements into user stories, product requirements, and acceptance criteria.

Experience leading Agile product delivery with cross-functional teams. Understanding of Data Governance, Analytics, Responsible AI, and AI governance principles. Strong stakeholder management, communication, facilitation, and presentation skills. Advanced English proficiency.

You Will Be Accountable for the Following Responsibilities: Define and maintain the AI product vision, strategy, and roadmap aligned with business objectives. Prioritize product initiatives based on business value, technical feasibility, ROI, and organizational impact. Own and manage the AI product backlog throughout the product lifecycle.

Translate business requirements into user stories, product requirements, and acceptance criteria. Lead AI product discovery sessions with business stakeholders. Drive the evolution of AI knowledge bases, Semantic Search, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), and Enterprise Intelligence capabilities.

Partner closely with Engineering, Data, Operations, and Executive Leadership to successfully deliver AI-powered products. Drive stakeholder engagement, product adoption, organizational alignment, and change management initiatives. Define, monitor, and optimize product KPIs, business outcomes, and value realization metrics.

Ensure Responsible AI, governance, compliance, and best practices are incorporated throughout the product lifecycle. Continuously improve AI products through customer feedback, experimentation, and iterative delivery.

Communicate AI capabilities, risks, limitations, and opportunities to both technical and business audiences. 5+ years of experience as a Product Manager or Product Owner. Experience building AI-powered products, including Generative AI, LLMs, RAG, or AI Agents. Experience defining product strategy, roadmaps, KPIs, and managing product backlogs.

Strong understanding of Machine Learning concepts and AI governance. Advanced English proficiency. About Us We Are Engineered Different. At Applaudo, talented people design, build, and scale meaningful, AI-powered solutions that create real business impact.

As an AI-native organization, we collaborate across design, development, cloud, data, and artificial intelligence to turn ideas into scalable products that transform how companies operate, make decisions, and grow.

We are building a high-performance culture grounded in five values: Empowering Excellence, Collaborative Teamwork, Unsolicited Respect, Consistent Transparency, and Efficient Communication . These define how we work, how we support one another, and how we hold ourselves accountable.

Applaudo is a place for people who want to learn fast, take ownership, and work alongside strong teams they are proud to belong to. Joining us means being part of an organization that is evolving intentionally, investing in modern ways of working, and leading AI-native transformation at scale. Originally posted on Himalayas

Job Description: We believe in bold ideas, diverse perspectives, and the drive to transform knowledge into impact. Here, your curiosity fuels progress, your voice shapes innovation, and your ambition helps redefine what’s possible within science and learning.

We are a culture that obsesses over impact, challenges, and drives what’s next to power infinite possibilities for our customers, colleagues and society at large. About the Role: Wiley Science Solutions is seeking an Associate Product Manager to support the development of online products, APIs, and scientific software platforms.

This role will work closely with product managers, engineering, content, marketing, sales, and customer-facing teams to help gather requirements, maintain product backlogs, support releases, and document customer needs.

The role is suited to an early-career candidate who is organized, analytical, curious, and interested in building a career in product management at the intersection of science, software, and data. This position will report to a Product Manager or Senior Product Manager within Wiley Science Solutions.

Job Responsibilities: Support the definition and documentation of product requirements and user stories. Assist with backlog management, sprint planning, and release coordination. Gather and summarize customer feedback, enhancement requests, and product issues.

Participate in customer interviews and market research activities to better understand scientific workflows and customer needs. Help track product adoption, customer engagement, and usage metrics. Maintain product documentation, release notes, and knowledge resources.

Collaborate with engineering, content, QA, marketing, sales, and customer success teams. Required Qualifications: Bachelor's degree in science, engineering, computer science, information systems, business, or a related field. Strong analytical, organizational, and communication skills.

Interest in scientific software, data products, APIs, SaaS platforms, or technology-enabled research solutions. Ability to work effectively in a dynamic, collaborative, cross-functional environment. Ability to learn technical and scientific concepts and communicate them clearly.

Preferred Qualifications: Academic background or coursework in chemistry, life sciences, materials science, data science, informatics, or related scientific fields. Familiarity with Agile development practices and tools such as Jira or Azure DevOps. Exposure to APIs, web applications, SaaS products, or digital platforms.

Experience in laboratory, research, scientific software, or technical customer-facing environments. Basic understanding of product analytics or usage reporting. We power infinite possibilities. For more than 200 years, we've transformed knowledge into discoveries that shape the world.

Today, our global team of innovators, creators, and experts is driving what's next in science, education, and publishing—creating impact that reaches everywhere. We're not just observers of progress. We're the ones accelerating scientific breakthroughs, advancing learning, and sparking innovation that redefines entire fields and improves lives.

Here, your talent matters. Your ideas have room to grow. And your work creates breakthroughs that can change everything. Wiley is an equal opportunity/affirmative action employer.

We evaluate all qualified applicants and treat all qualified applicants and employees without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, genetic information, or based on any individual's status in any group or class protected by applicable federal, state or local laws.

Wiley is also committed to providing reasonable accommodation to applicants and employees with disabilities. Applicants who require accommodation to participate in the job application process may contact tasupport@wiley.com for assistance. We are proud that our workplace promotes continual learning and internal mobility.

Our values support courageous teammates, needle movers, and learning champions all while striving to support the health and well-being of all employees.

We offer meeting-free Friday afternoons allowing more time for heads down work and professional development, and through a robust body of employee programing we facilitate a wide range of opportunities to foster community, learn, and grow.

We are committed to fair, transparent pay, and we strive to provide competitive compensation in addition to a comprehensive benefits package.

The range below represents Wiley 's good faith and reasonable estimate of the base pay for this role at the time of posting roles in the United Kingdom, Canada, USA, Austria, Czechia, Denmark, France, Greece, Italy, Netherlands, Romania, or Spain.

It is anticipated that most qualified candidates will fall within the range, however the ultimate salary offered for this role may be higher or lower and will be set based on a variety of non-discriminatory factors, including but not limited to, geographic location, skills, and competencies.

When applying, please attach your resume/CV to be considered. Salary Range: 63,200.00 CAD to 88,400.00 CAD Originally posted on Himalayas

Who we are At Fluxon , we believe that how you build matters as much as what you build. We help businesses navigate their most important technology decisions with confidence, and take responsibility for seeing them through.

Founded by ex-Googlers and startup veterans, we’re proud to partner with teams behind some of the most ambitious products, including Open AI, Anthropic, Stripe, Walmart and Google. Our work spans strategy, design, and engineering — often in complex, AI-driven environments — where clarity, speed and quality are the standard.

We use AI intentionally, applying it only where it adds real value and expands what’s possible. Care shapes everything we do. Inside Fluxon , you’ll find a global, remote-first team of experienced builders, who are curious, kind and serious about their craft.

We’re building a place where people can take ownership, solve problems that matter and do work they’re proud to stand behind. If you want to do your best work alongside people who care as much as you do, you’ll feel at home here. Many of our team members call the Bay Area home, but this role is fully remote across North America.

About the role As a Product Manager at Fluxon , you’ll be the strategic driving force at the center of our team and a trusted partner to our customers. We’re looking for someone who craves having real impact and ownership.

While specific responsibilities may differ from project to project, you will: Develop expertise in a variety of customer domains such as AI, healthcare, SaaS, eCommerce, and many others Build deep partnerships with startups and tech leaders alike to understand their product, users, and help drive key strategic decisions Establish a clear product vision and connect the dots across functions and organizations Communicate roadmaps, decisions, and learnings across a wide range of audiences from development teams to executives Lead full product and feature development cycles from discovery to delivery Qualifications 5+ years of product management experience Proven ability to thrive within ambiguity by applying a mix of research, analytics, intuition, and empathy to tackle problems Experience taking multiple products/feature sets through the entire development life cycle, from ideation to launch Clear and structured communicator, can turn big ideas into actionable roadmaps with clear goals and align multiple levels of stakeholders Excited about solving complex problems, building innovative products, and learning alongside a world-class team What we offer Our salary range for this role is $160,000- $200,000 USD per year.

We determine individual offers based on your skills and experience, what similar roles pay at comparable companies, and cost-of-living differences by location.

Remote work with flexible hours and a budget to set up your work space Localized healthcare coverage designed to support you and your family’s well-being Flexible paid time off with a 3-week minimum (not including holidays) to support your well-being Company-wide "no internal meetings" Fridays to help you focus on deep, uninterrupted work Professional growth budget for any form of self-improvement: specialized technical training, conferences, certifications or even foreign language courses Monthly health & wellness allowance to spend on whatever keeps you physically and mentally at your best Annual offsites where we gather in person to build meaningful connections with your fellow Fluxon ians Profit-sharing program for you to benefit directly from our collective growth and success Paid sabbatical program to reset, recharge, and gain a fresh perspective A competitive salary that reflects your expertise and experience We believe diverse teams perform better, and an inclusive environment is essential to building a successful organization.

We welcome applicants from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We are an equal opportunity employer and are committed to providing accommodations throughout the hiring process. This role may use AI-assisted tools to support initial screening. All assessments and decisions are made by a human reviewer. Originally posted on Himalayas

Die dokSAFE GmbH ist ein Leipziger Softwareunternehmen, das sich auf die Entwicklung der SaaS-Lösung Actaport spezialisiert hat. Wir arbeiten gemeinsam daran, mit unserer Kanzleisoftware die Arbeitswelt in der Anwaltskanzlei zu revolutionieren.
Du willst nicht nur Anforderungen verwalten, sondern ein Produkt wirklich gestalten — nah an Kunden, nah an der Rechtspraxis und nah am Entwicklungsteam? Dann suchen wir genau DICH! Als Product Owner (m/w/d) trägst Du die Verantwortung für die Weiterentwicklung von ACTAPORT von der Anforderungsaufnahme über die Backlog-Priorisierung bis zum Release.

Du übersetzt juristische und gesetzliche Anforderungen in konkretes Produktdesign — und sorgst dafür, dass das, was wir bauen, auch wirklich genutzt wird.
Aufgaben
Du verantwortest die Weiterentwicklung unserer Kanzleisoftware von der Konzeption bis zum Release und behältst dabei Nutzerbedürfnisse, gesetzliche Anforderungen und Produktvision gleichzeitig im Blick.
Du nimmst Anforderungen von Kunden und dem Gesetzgeber auf, analysierst sie und überführst sie in praxis- und benutzerorientierte Funktionen.
Du agierst als enger Sparringspartner für das Entwicklungsteam, um Rückfragen zu klären, Scope zu schärfen, Prioritäten verständlich zu machen und Blocker früh aufzulösen.
Du pflegst und priorisierst das Product Backlog und begleitest den Entwicklungsprozess in enger Zusammenarbeit mit dem Entwicklungsteam nach agilen Methoden (bspw. Scrum).
Du präsentierst Produktfortschritte gegenüber Stakeholdern, unterstützt bei der Qualitätssicherung und gibst dem Team klares Feedback zu Akzeptanzkriterien.
Du dokumentierst neue Funktionen und schulst bei Bedarf Mitarbeitende und Kund:innen.
Qualifikation
Ein abgeschlossenes Studium der Rechtswissenschaften, Betriebswirtschaftslehre, der IT oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation bildet die Grundlage — entscheidend ist Dein Verständnis für juristische Prozesse und Nutzerbedürfnisse.
Du verfügst über eine Zertifizierung nach CSPO oder PSPO 1.
Du arbeitest strukturiert, detailorientiert und eigenverantwortlich und hast ein ausgeprägtes Gespür für UI/UX.
Du interessierst Dich für digitale Trends, KI und Legal Tech und bringst technische Affinität für Cloud-Software mit.
Deine sehr guten Deutsch- sowie Englischkenntnisse ermöglichen eine reibungslose Kommunikation im Team und mit Stakeholdern, um Ideen effektiv zu teilen und Ziele gemeinsam zu erreichen.

Wir bieten eine sehr gute Work-Life-Balance durch flexible Arbeitszeiten.
Wir leben ein hybrides Arbeitsmodell — Homeoffice ist bei uns selbstverständlich möglich.
Neben 30 Urlaubstagen erhältst Du eine sehr gute Vergütung und zusätzliche finanzielle Benefits (Kitazuschuss, steuerfreier Sachbezug als Deutschlandticket oder 50€-Gutschein).
Wir statten Dich mit modernen Arbeitsgeräten und einer zeitgemäßen Entwicklungsumgebung aus — Du entscheidest, womit Du am liebsten arbeitest.
Dich erwarten flache Hierarchien und kurze Entscheidungswege.
Dich begrüßen erfahrene Teamplayer in einem motivierten, inklusiven Team. Nach Deiner ausführlichen Einarbeitung arbeitest Du eigenverantwortlich in diesem.
Dich erwarten vielfältige Möglichkeiten für Deine persönliche und fachliche Entwicklung sowie eine optionale betriebliche Altersvorsorge.
Werde Teil unseres Teams und revolutioniere mit uns die Arbeitswelt in Anwaltskanzleien. Gestalte Deine Zukunft bei dokSAFE GmbH und bewirb Dich jetzt - wir freuen uns auf Dich!

Location Our Technical Product Owner - DoiT Cloud Intelligence - Core Services will be an integral part of our global Product team. This role is based remotely in the East Coast US, the UK, Ireland, Estonia, the Netherlands, Sweden and Israel.

Who We Are DoiT is a global technology company that works with cloud-driven organizations to leverage the cloud to drive business growth and innovation. We combine data, technology, and human expertise to ensure our customers operate in a well-architected and scalable state - from planning to production.

Delivering DoiT Cloud Intelligence, the only solution that integrates advanced technology with human intelligence, we help our customers solve complex multi-cloud problems and drive efficiency. With decades of multi-cloud experience, we have specializations in Kubernetes, GenAI, CloudOps, and more.

An award-winning strategic partner of AWS, Google Cloud, and Microsoft Azure, we work alongside more than 4,000 customers worldwide.

The Opportunity We’re hiring a Technical Product Owner to drive rapid delivery and iteration for the Core Services team of DoiT Cloud Intelligence, our platform that helps DevOps, Cloud Infrastructure, and FinOps teams manage public cloud environments effectively and efficiently.

Core Services builds and operates foundational platform capabilities used across DoiT’s products and engineering teams. Its responsibilities include identity and access management, authentication and authorization, customer and tenant services, shared APIs, platform integrations, and other cross-cutting capabilities.

This role is designed for someone with a technical product mindset who is comfortable working deep within platform architecture, distributed systems, APIs, cloud infrastructure, and internal engineering workflows.

You will help turn broad platform needs into clear technical product direction, sequenced investments, and reliably delivered capabilities. You will report to a VP of Product and work as an embedded member of the Core Services Engineering team.

You will collaborate closely with engineering leadership, architects, security, product teams, and internal platform consumers to determine what the team should build next and why. Role clarity: VP of Product vs. Technical Product Owner VP of Product (what they own)
Sets the overall vision, strategy, positioning, and long-range roadmap for the platform area.
Makes the highest-level prioritization calls across multiple components and investment themes.
Aligns stakeholders across the company (executive leadership, GTM, partners) on direction and tradeoffs.
Defines success at the portfolio/area level and ensures the area’s outcomes ladder up to company goals.
Technical Product Owner (what you own)
Owns delivery, iteration, and learning velocity for the Core Services.
Turns VP-level direction into clear problems to solve, a prioritized backlog, and incrementally shippable scope.
Runs the feedback loop: discover → define → build → release → measure → iterate, repeatedly.
Works within the Engineering teams to ensure they are always building the highest-value next increment with clarity, quality
Review technical designs, reason about tradeoffs and constraints, and understand their impact on delivery timelines and system behavior, without being the primary implementer
Leverages deep, hands-on DevOps experience and public cloud understanding to ensure that solution implementations are done correctly
This distinction matters: the VP creates the “why” and “where”; the Product Owner ensures the “what next” is always sharp, validated, and shipping. Responsibilities Fast iteration and backlog leadership
Translate the VP’s strategy into a sequenced backlog of problems, user stories, and acceptance criteria that the Engineering team can deliver continuously.
Keep work “thin-sliced” so the team can ship frequently, learn quickly, and reduce risk through iteration.
Maintain a disciplined cadence of backlog refinement, sprint readiness, and scope negotiation to keep delivery predictable without slowing innovation.
Deep user and workflow understanding
Leverage your hands-on DevOps experience and expertise in the real-world workflows of the professionals you’re building for - especially cloud operators and practitioners.
Use firsthand domain knowledge and ongoing customer conversations to identify friction, gaps, and opportunities for differentiation.
Prioritize enhancements that materially improve outcomes: speed, reliability, clarity, safety, governance, cost impact, or operational simplicity.
Customer validation and external communication
Often speak with customers (aiming for 3-5 calls a week) and cross-functional DoiT stakeholders regularly to test ideas, validate assumptions, and pressure-test tradeoffs.
Communicate clearly and confidently: share concepts early, take feedback openly, synthesize input into decisions, and explain “why” in a way that builds trust.
Rely on your hands-on, DevOps experience to go deep with stakeholders (internal/external) into the technical details of the problem, our solution, and the contexts and environments in which both of these exist.
Support beta/design-partner motions where appropriate by shaping hypotheses, success criteria, and rollout plans.
Engineering-embedded technical product ownership
Operate as a core member of the Core Services’ Engineering team - present in daily collaboration, crisp in decision-making, and pragmatic about constraints.
Partner with Engineering leads on sequencing, technical tradeoffs, and delivery planning - ensuring product intent survives implementation realities.
Ensure Core Services are cohesive across UX, APIs, data, and operational behavior - and that it meets a high bar for reliability and customer trust.
Quality, outcomes, and measurement
Define what “success” means for Core Services with clear metrics (adoption, activation, workflow completion, time-to-value, retention, reliability signals, customer-reported impact).
Instrument learning: make sure releases are measurable and that insights reliably flow back into prioritization.
Own release readiness for Core Services: documentation, enablement inputs, and clear communication of what’s new and why it matters.
Safety, governance, and trust by design
Ensure product requirements account for real-world cloud environments: IAM boundaries, auditability, guardrails, and safe defaults.
Partner with security, support, and customer teams to anticipate edge cases and ensure Core Services earns trust over time.

7–10 years of hands-on experience as a Platform Engineer, DevOps Engineer, SRE, Cloud Engineer, Solutions Architect, or a similar roles working with or building products for public cloud infrastructure (AWS, GCP, and/or Azure).
A strong product sense for turning messy problems into clear scope and shipped value - without waiting for perfect information.
Systems thinking: Ability to reason about complex distributed systems, architectural tradeoffs, and long-term platform evolution.
Prioritization: Demonstrated ability to balance customer needs, engineering constraints, and platform investments when making prioritization decisions.

Dataiku is the Platform for AI Success, the enterprise orchestration layer for building, deploying, and governing AI. In a single environment, teams design and operate analytics, machine learning, and AI agents with the transparency, collaboration, and control enterprises require. Sitting above data platforms, cloud infrastructure, and AI services, Dataiku connects the full enterprise AI stack - empowering organizations to run AI across multi-vendor environments with centralized governance.
The world’s leading companies rely on Dataiku to operationalize AI and run it as a true business performance engine delivering measurable value. For more, visit the Dataiku blog , LinkedIn , X , and YouTube .
How you'll make an impact
You will play a pivotal role in shaping Dataiku's product positioning, roadmap, and requirements for predictive analytics, machine learning, and GenAI under the responsibilities of the Director of Product Management in charge of Dataiku AI/ML offering. You will work with stakeholders across all parts of the business, including Engineering, Product, GTM, Partners, Marketing Operations, and Customer Success teams, to execute growth projects and new products and features.
Your challenge is to identify and shape net new capabilities: innovations that are core additions to the product, discovered through deep customer engagement and validated before engineering commits. You are not here to maintain what exists in the long run, you will work with Technical Product Managers. You are here to find what's missing and make the case for building it.
If you're ready to step into a role where your expertise leads to tangible, wide-scale impact, where every insight you gather shapes the future of our products, we're waiting for you!
What you’ll be doing
Embed with strategic customers to run structured discovery (interviews, async collaboration, or on-site visits) to surface unmet needs before they're obvious to competitors.
Analyze usage and customer data to identify gaps and opportunities to enhance customer success and to deliver new capabilities with distinct business value propositions, ultimately contributing to the company's financial goals.
Analyze market forces and competition, engage with industry analysts and Dataiku teams to execute on Dataiku’s product strategy. Collaborate with the Product Marketing team to align and deliver on product positioning messages.
Build working prototypes (UI mockups, agentic pipeline demos, opportunity memos) to validate hypotheses with customers before engineering commits.
Synthesize field signals across accounts to distinguish incremental customer requests from genuine innovation opportunities (net new capabilities that would be core additions to the platform.)
Define and champion innovation initiatives from discovery through to launch, at which point ownership transitions to Technical Product Managers for ongoing improvements and maintenance.
At launch, partner with Technical Product Managers to produce enablement material for internal customers (Product Marketing and GTM Enablement) ensuring new capabilities and big delighters land with the right positioning, messaging, and field readiness.
Maintain the product backlog for the initiatives you own, constantly anticipating and aligning with the global product strategy and the software engineering delivery capacity.
Participate in the development, maintenance and education on the AI/ML roadmap. Articulate your team’s technology vision, requirements, goals and milestones to stakeholders.
What you will NOT be doing
Managing the full lifecycle of every feature you touch, your focus ends when a capability reaches steady state. You will focus on product discovery and prioritization to maximize value creation and minimize the risk of shipping the right solution to the wrong problem, not on managing maintenance priorities or driving small incremental improvements to existing capabilities.
Product management focused on feature development, you work closely with your Technical Product Managers (PO) counterparts to ensure the engineering team gets what they need to deliver the capability at the right time, you do not dive into technical analysis.
Shipping production solutions to customers. You build prototypes and demos to get clarity about the problem customers face or to support compelling roadmap presentations.
Being evaluated on ARR. Example of success metrics are # of validated opportunities that made it into engineering commit, NPS of sessions with customers, time from discovery to roadmap entry.
What you’ll need to be successful
5+ years of experience in a similar role and a demonstrated ability to learn and thrive in front of a diverse audience in a very technical environment
3+ years hands-on experience with building AI/ML solutions (e.g. advanced analytics, predictive analytics, GenAI-powered applications)
Can prototype: Build and demo agentic applications in Dataiku or elsewhere, not just slides. You don't need to be a software engineer, but you produce tangible artifacts that make ideas testable.
Ability to engage with business leaders and influence decisions
Proven ability to influence cross-functional teams without formal authority
What are you waiting for!
At Dataiku, you'll be part of a journey to shape the ever-evolving world of AI. We're not just building a product; we're crafting the future of AI. If you're ready to make a significant impact in a company that values innovation, collaboration, and your personal growth, we can't wait to welcome you to Dataiku! SKALAR – Wir bauen die digitale Steuerkanzlei der Zukunft
Radikal einfach. Voll digital. 100% mandantenfokussiert.
Wir denken Steuerberatung komplett neu: einfacher, schneller und transparenter für Mandanten und Kanzleiteam zugleich.
Wo andere Kanzleien mit manuellen Prozessen, langen Wartezeiten und intransparenter Kommunikation kämpfen, bauen wir ein völlig neues Erlebnis - digital, proaktiv, KI-gestützt. Mit automatisierten Prozessen im Hintergrund und digitalen Schnittstellen zum Mandanten laufen repetitive Aufgaben weitgehend von selbst - damit du Zeit hast für das, was wirklich zählt: anspruchsvolle Beratung, Sonderfälle und strategische Mandantenfragen.
Der Unterschied zu anderen "Digitalkanzleien": Über die Hälfte unseres Teams sind Softwareentwickler. Du gestaltest direkt mit, was sie bauen - und damit, wie KI-gestützte Steuerberatung in dieser Branche überhaupt aussehen wird. Dein Steuerwissen prägt das Produkt, nicht nur dessen Anwendung.
Wir sind ein erfahrenes Gründerteam aus Steuerberatern, Digital-Unternehmern und Softwareentwicklern mit einem Exit-Track-Record von 140 Mio. €. Mit dir gemeinsam möchten wir eine der führenden Kanzleien Deutschlands aufbauen.
Deine Mission
KI-Features liefern, die Zahlen bewegen: Du verantwortest KI-Features end-to-end – Belegerkennung, Klassifizierung, automatisches Verfassen von Steuer-Antwortschreiben, RAG über Mandantenakten. Du baust die Eval-Frameworks, fährst die Prompt-Iterationen und triffst die Build-vs-Buy-Entscheidungen zu Modellen und Tooling. Keine Übergaben, keine Ausreden.
Werde besessen vom Nutzer: Du betreibst Discovery auf die harte Tour: Interviews, Shadowing-Sessions, Synthese von Rohfeedback. Du gehst tief genug, um echte von angenommenen Problemen zu unterscheiden – und wirst zur schärfsten Stimme des Nutzers in deiner Produktlinie.
Verantworte die Roadmap, verteidige die Trade-offs: Du verantwortest die Roadmap deiner Produktlinie end-to-end. Priorisierung über Geschäftswert, technische Machbarkeit und regulatorische Passung. Du kommunizierst Trade-offs klar an Engineering, Steuerberatung und Gründer – und verteidigst deine Entscheidungen mit Daten.
Halte die Messlatte beim Design: Du setzt einen hohen visuellen Standard und schützt ihn. Figma-Souveränität auf Review- und Skizzen-Niveau: Du entwirfst Flows, kritisierst Komponenten und blockst alles ab, was den Standard nicht erfüllt. Die beste Steuer-UX ist unsichtbar – mach unsere unsichtbar.
Laufe auf Daten, nicht auf Bauchgefühl: Du definierst die KPIs, die zählen – Time-to-Filing, Automatisierungsrate, Mandantenzufriedenheit, Berater-Effizienz – und steuerst jede Iteration aus Dashboards. Bauchgefühl bringt hier keine Features in Produktion.
Treibe die KI-Frontier: Du folgst der KI-Debatte nicht – du treibst sie. Evals, Prompt-Iteration, Kosten-Qualitäts-Trade-offs in Produktion. Du experimentierst unermüdlich mit dem Möglichen und bringst die Speerspitze ins Produkt.
Sei das Bindegewebe: Du sitzt zwischen Engineering, Steuerberatung und Mandanten und machst die Organisation dadurch schneller. First-Principles-Denken.
Dein Profil
Produkterfahrung: 3–6 Jahre Produktmanagement in B2B-SaaS, FinTech, Finance, Tax oder einem vergleichbar komplexen Umfeld. Du kannst auf Features verweisen, die du von der Vision bis zur messbaren Wirkung verantwortet hast – nicht auf Features, an denen du mitgewirkt hast.
KI-Track-Record: Mindestens ein KI-/LLM-Feature in Produktion ausgeliefert – mit echten Evals, Prompt-Iteration und Verantwortung für Kosten-Qualitäts-Trade-offs. Solides Verständnis moderner LLM-Stacks: RAG, Prompt Engineering, Fine-Tuning vs. In-Context-Learning, Vektor-Stores. ChatGPT-Prompts zählen nicht – wir wollen KI-native Workflows, die du tatsächlich gebaut hast.
Mandanten-Empathie, die sich übersetzt: Echte Empathie für beide Seiten – den Berater unter Fristendruck und den Mandanten, der einfach Sicherheit will – und die Disziplin, diese Empathie in Produktentscheidungen zu übersetzen, nicht in Backlog-Items.
Auge fürs Design: Figma-Souveränität auf Skizzen- und Review-Niveau. Klare Meinungen dazu, wie gute UI aussieht, und null Toleranz für schlampige Interfaces. Begeisterung für Claude Design ist ein Plus.

Travel: Up to 20% (trade shows, studio visits, JDM/ODM partners)
Are you passionate about professional studio monitors and the craft of making music?
Do you have a strong track record in hardware product management?
Do you enjoy working in fast-paced, cross-functional teams to bring exciting and technically challenging new product ideas to life?
We are looking for a forward-thinking and experienced Product Manager to own one or more of our active studio monitor lines end-to-end - from customer insight and business case, through requirements definition and stage-gate development, to launch and life in the market.
Reporting to the Head of Product, you will be the cross-functional centre of your line(s) and make trade-offs on features, performance, cost and timing that get exceptional monitors into the hands of the creatives, engineers, producers and mixers who trust ADAM Audio.

You will own the full lifecycle of one or more assigned studio monitor lines through opportunity framing, pre-development, stage-gate delivery, release and post-launch.
You will monitor, document and analyse customer needs, production workflows, competitor moves and channel dynamics through structured desk research, user interviews, studio visits, dealer feedback, industry research and product testing - turning that into a defensible point of view for the roadmap.
Working in close collaboration with the sales regions during the entire PM process, you will build structured proposals and business cases for new products, refreshes and running changes - including ASP, target BOM, gross margin, volume scenarios and pricing recommendation - for evaluation by Product Leadership and the Exec Team.
You will translate opportunities into concise PRDs with clear acceptance criteria, balancing user value against technical feasibility across acoustics, electronics, firmware, software, and mechanics.
You will partner with R&D, Project Management, JDM/ODM partners, Operations and Marketing, to make trade-offs on features, performance, cost and timing to meet market windows and business objectives.
You will act as the internal hub across ADAM Audio, ensuring coordination and information flow across R&D, Sales, Marketing, Operations and Support throughout development and commercialisation.
You will support go-to-market with pricing strategy, competitive positioning, messaging and go-to-market artefacts (data-sheets, user guides, documentation); track post-launch performance and adjust strategy accordingly.
You will monitor in-market response and quality (warranty rates, returns, support tickets, dealer feedback) and prioritise maintenance releases, firmware updates and running changes based on business and user impact.
You will represent your products at internal and external events - trade conferences, dealer visits, product launches - and act as a credible point of contact for users.
Individual and team development is important, and we will support you as you look for ways to grow and improve your personal knowledge and skills. We will also be looking for you to own and help improve our approach to engineering and design knowledge, including best practices, processes, and tools. There will be the opportunity to share knowledge and practices with all companies across the Focusrite group.

Minimum 5 years of Hardware Product Management experience in professional audio or consumer electronics.
A working command of the loudspeaker stack to be a credible peer to R&D; you can specify a frequency plot and ask the right questions on the measurements.
Strong commercial and financial acumen, with the ability to author a business case, build volume and margin scenarios and reason about unit economics.
Confidence in designing and running listening tests, structured user interviews and studio visits, and translating subjective audio judgement and objective measurement into specific, actionable requirements.
Excellent communication skills in English, both written and spoken - German language skills are a strong advantage.
Comfort in working autonomously in fast-paced, ambiguous environments and juggling multiple large projects simultaneously.
A genuine passion for music, audio and the creative process, with a feel for what studio professionals actually do with our products.
Willingness to travel up to 20% of the time (trade shows, studio visits, JDM partners in Asia, Focusrite Group regional visits).

A Bachelor's or Master's degree in Engineering, Physics, Music Technology, Business or a related discipline; MBA or equivalent is a plus.
Direct experience in studio monitors, live sound, hi-fi loudspeakers or other professional acoustic products.
Experience working across regional sales organisations inside a group structure.
Familiarity with Asian culture and etiquette (JDM/ODM partner management).

We’re looking for people who will thrive in our team and contribute to our culture—not just candidates who tick every box. If you’re excited about this role but your experience doesn’t perfectly match every qualification listed, we’d still love to hear from you. Tell us what you would bring to the role and why you’d be a great addition to the team.
We believe that diverse perspectives, experiences, and backgrounds make us stronger. As an inclusive employer, we welcome applications from all qualified candidates, including people with disabilities. If you need any reasonable adjustments during the recruitment process, please let us know—we’ll be happy to support you.
We look forward to receiving your application!

ADAM Audio GmbH is a rapidly growing, internationally positioned Focusrite plc company based in Berlin Adlershof.
We are one of the market-leading manufacturers of professional monitoring solutions.
Our customers include renowned recording studios and well-known music producers all over the world, and our products have also been used to soundtrack numerous Oscar-nominated films in recent years.
Since 2019, ADAM Audio has been part of Focusrite plc which houses other, highly respected pro audio brands like Martin Audio, Optimal Audio, Sequential, Focusrite, Focusrite Pro, Novation and Ampify. Our international team at the Berlin-based HQ and the office in China live our passion for music. We constantly drive ourselves to bring fresh ideas and new technologies to our high-quality products to meet the needs of pro audio enthusiasts and recording professionals alike.
We pride ourselves in providing some of the tools that empower creatives all over the world to bring their visions to life. Covering a wide range of products for different levels and budgets, we engage with artists, producers and engineers to become a companion throughout the various stages of their journey.
Our whole business is structured to let everyone contribute and be heard at all levels, and we make sure it’s a great place to work. As a team, we work hard and support each other to master our individual tasks, building and developing the skills of talented and passionate people – to achieve a common goal. So, if you think you can bring something new to the mix, we look forward to hearing from you.

___________________________________________________________________________ DEXIOS ist unsere Cloud-Plattform für Zutrittskontrolle, Zutrittsmanagement und Zeiterfassung. Die Software ist live, sie ist noch jung, und sie steht jetzt an dem Punkt, an dem aus einem funktionierenden Produkt eine skalierbare SaaS-Lösung wird.
Du übernimmst die Produktverantwortung für diesen Weg: Du entscheidest, was gebaut wird, in welcher Reihenfolge und warum. Du arbeitest nah an der Entwicklung, am Backlog in GitHub und an Architekturdiskussionen, und du verantwortest die Roadmap gegenüber Geschäftsführung, Vertrieb, Marketing, Projektgruppe und Support.
In dieser Rolle hast du viel Gestaltungsspielraum: Wenn du die nächsten Jahre lieber ein Produkt von innen prägen willst als ein fertiges zu verwalten - lies weiter!
Deine Aufgaben PRODUKT – Roadmap und Priorisierung
Du verantwortest die DEXIOS-Roadmap und entscheidest laufend, welche Themen jetzt zählen und welche warten
Du priorisierst gegen Nutzen, Aufwand und Marktchance und kannst deine Entscheidungen gegenüber Geschäftsführung, Vertrieb und Kunden vertreten
Du schneidest Anforderungen so, dass sie umsetzbar sind: User Stories, Akzeptanzkriterien, sinnvolle Releasegrößen
Du pflegst das Backlog in GitHub und arbeitest im Sprint-Rhythmus direkt mit dem Entwicklungsteam
TECHNIK – Architektur und Systemlogik
Du verstehst, wie DEXIOS funktioniert: Mandantenfähigkeit, Rollen- und Rechtemodelle, Berechtigungslogiken, IAM-Anbindung über OAuth 2.0 / OpenID Connect, Konnektoren zu Entra ID, SAP und HR-Systemen
Du diskutierst mit Entwicklung und SW- Architektur auf Augenhöhe über Machbarkeit, Abhängigkeiten und technische Schulden und hast Spaß daran den Prozess proaktiv zu moderieren, um eine Lösung zu finden
Code schreiben gehört nicht dazu - aber die Logik hinter dem System interessiert dich, und du kennst sie gut genug, so dass deine Priorisierung trägt
UX – wie Menschen mit DEXIOS (und zukünftig mit KI) arbeiten
Du hast eine Haltung dazu, wie sich Frontends durch KI verändern: Was bleibt Klickpfad, was wird Dialog, was läuft automatisch im Hintergrund?
Du trägst zur positiven User Experience bei: Wie kommen Sicherheitsverantwortliche, HR-Mitarbeitende oder der Werkschutz mit dem System zurecht, heute und in drei Jahren?
Die Designgrundlagen von DEXIOS stehen. Du arbeitest damit, entwickelst sie weiter und machst die Vorgaben für User Flows bis hin zu Bedienlogiken
KI – in der Rolle und im Produkt
Du nutzt KI in deiner täglichen Arbeit: Prototypen, User Stories, Analysen, Backlog-Aufbereitung, Kundenfeedback verdichten
Du baust Prototypen selbst, statt auf Kapazität zu warten. Ein klickbarer Prototyp in zwei Stunden bringt uns weiter als ein theoretisches Konzept in zwei Wochen
Du bringst deine Perspektive ein, wo KI im Produkt echten Nutzen schafft und wo sie nur Aufsatz wäre
TEAM – Schnittstellen
Du gehst proaktiv auf Kollegen zu, schaffst regelmäßigen Dialog und sorgst dafür, dass Anforderungen, Prioritäten und Entscheidungen für alle Stakeholder nachvollziehbar sind
Du holst Feedback von Kunden sowie aus Support-Anfragen und übersetzt diese in Produktentscheidungen
Du bist bei Kundenterminen dabei, wenn es hilft, und regelmäßig vor Ort in München, weil gute Entscheidungen meist im Gespräch entstehen
PROFIL – Dein Kompetenzset
Du hast mehrjährige Erfahrung als Product Owner oder technischer Produktmanager (m/w/d) für ein Softwareprodukt, davon mindestens zwei Jahre mit echtem Ownership – du hast das Software- oder SaaS-Produkt verantwortet und durch relevante Reifephasen geführt.
Cloud- und SaaS-Architekturen, APIs und Datenmodelle sind dir vertraut: Du liest eine Schnittstellenbeschreibung, ohne dass jemand sie dir erklärt
KI ist Teil deiner Arbeitsweise, nicht ein Punkt auf deiner Skill-Liste. Du kannst konkret erzählen, wofür du sie zuletzt eingesetzt hast, und auch, wann sie dich falsch beraten hat
Du kommunizierst und verhandelst sicher auf Deutsch und Englisch und hast ein Bewusstsein für Informationssicherheit (ISO 27001)
Was diese Rolle nicht ist
Kein Ticket-Schreiben nach fremder Vorgabe. Die Roadmap kommt von dir
Keine reine Strategie-Rolle mit Folien. Du arbeitest im Sprint mit
Kein Scrum-Master-Job. Prozesspflege ist nicht der Kern
Kein fertiges Produkt mit fertigen Prozessen. Vieles bauen wir gerade erst auf, das ist Freiheit und Arbeit zugleich
Das bieten wir Produktverantwortung mit Mandat. Kurze Wege, direkte Berichtslinie an die Leitung der Business Unit, Entscheidungen ohne Gremienmarathon
Eines der spannendsten Themen im Markt: Zutrittsmanagement wandert in die Cloud, und PCS gestaltet diesen Wandel mit einem eigenen Produkt statt mit Zukäufen
KI-Werkzeuge, die du wirklich nutzen darfst. Lizenzen, Zeit zum Ausprobieren und ein Umfeld, das KI-gestütztes Arbeiten erwartet statt duldet
Ein Team, das für Zusammenhalt und Wertschätzung steht, mit flachen Strukturen und Raum für eigene Ideen
Gleitzeit, 30 Tage Urlaub (bei Vollzeit), Homeoffice-Anteil, unbefristete Festanstellung
Attraktives Einkommen sowie Benefits wie Team- und Firmenevents, Firmen-Fitnessangebot und Dienstrad-Leasing

Unternehmensbeschreibung
Bei Bosch gestalten wir Zukunft mit hochwertigen Technologien und Dienstleistungen, die Begeisterung wecken und das Leben der Menschen verbessern. Unser Versprechen an dich steht dabei felsenfest: Wir wachsen gemeinsam, haben Freude an unserer Arbeit und inspirieren uns gegenseitig.
sia Abrasives ist ein international tätiges Unternehmen der Bosch\-Gruppe und einer der führenden Schleifmittelhersteller weltweit. Wir entwickeln, produzieren und vertreiben hochwertige Schleifmittel sowie kundenorientierte Systemlösungen zum Erzielen perfekter Oberflächen. So veredeln unsere Produkte die Oberflächen von Uhren, Autos, Flugzeugen, Designermöbeln und vielem mehr.
Stellenbeschreibung
In dieser spannenden Position übernimmst du die Funktion des Junior\-Produktmanagers für definierte Produktserien. Du wirst von Beginn an in das Management unseres ganzheitlichen Produktlebenszyklus eingebunden und übernimmst schrittweise die Verantwortung für dein eigenes Portfolio.

Produkt\- \& Portfolioverantwortung: Du treibst aktiv den Erfolg deiner Produktlinien voran, agierst als kompetenter Ansprechpartner für dein Portfolio und unterstützt den Vertrieb bei technischen Anfragen.
Eigenständige (Teil\-)Projektleitung: Du übernimmst schrittweise selbstständige Leitung kleinerer Projekte (z. B. die Koordination von Produktänderungen, länderspezifische Produkteinführungen oder die Erstellung neuer Demo\-Kits für den Vertrieb) und stellst deren Erfolg hinsichtlich Qualität, Kosten und Terminen sicher.
Nutzerzentrierte Innovation: Durch die Analyse von Kundenfeedback und das Erkennen von Nutzerbedürfnissen (User Experience / UX) formulierst du innovative Produkt\- und Lösungskonzepte.
Markt\- \& Wettbewerbsbeobachtung: Du erarbeitest dir ein tiefes Verständnis über unsere globalen Zielmärkte, Zielgruppen und Wettbewerber, um strategische Handlungsempfehlungen abzuleiten.

Datenmanagement: Du stellst die hohe Qualität und Pflege produktrelevanter Stammdaten in unseren Systemen sicher, um der Kommunikationsabteilung und dem Vertrieb optimale Verkaufsunterlagen bereitzustellen.
Diese Position ist Teil des PreMaster\-Programms für Bachelor\-Absolventen. Weitere Details zu dem Programm findest du unten.

Qualifikation: analytisches Denkvermögen, Berufserfahrung in ähnlicher Position im Bereich Produktmanagement oder Marketing wünschenswert
Know\-How: : Sehr gute MS Office\-Kenntnisse sowie eine hohe Affinität für digitale Trends und neue Technologien. Erste Erfahrungen oder ein starkes Interesse am praktischen Einsatz von Generative AI Tools sind ein klares Plus.
Arbeitsweise: strukturiert, verantwortungsbewusst, selbstständig
Persönlichkeit: Team Player, kommunikativ, motiviert, lernbereit, zuverlässig
Sprache: sehr gute Deutsch\- und Englischkenntnisse, jede weitere Sprache von Vorteil

About Wolt
At Wolt, we create technology that brings joy, simplicity and earnings to the neighborhoods of the world. In 2014 we started with delivery of restaurant food. Now we’re building the delivery of (almost) everything and you’ll find us in over 500 cities in 30 countries around the world. In 2022 we joined forces with DoorDash and together we keep on dreaming big and expanding across the globe.
Working at Wolt isn’t always easy, but it’s definitely exciting. Here you’ll learn more, build more, and ship more than in most other companies. You’ll be challenged a lot, but also have a lot of fun on the way. So, if you’re a self-starter with drive and entrepreneurial spirit, this could be the ride of your life.
We're looking for a Product Manager to own our search experience that millions of customers land on when they open DoorDash, Wolt, or Deliveroo, and the single biggest lever we have on what they find.
The role sits in our Core Consumer organisation in the Search domain, which is responsible for the in-app experience. You'll be building on a global stack, and your roadmap will be a mix: global platform problems that apply worldwide, global capabilities we're accelerating into EMEA markets, and EMEA-specific problems worth solving properly rather than working around.
Search is where customers tell us exactly what they want. Getting it right across restaurants, grocery, and retail - in every language we operate in - is one of the highest-intent and hardest problems in the app.
What you'll work on
Query understanding, Autosuggestions and AI/ML problems in the Search domain
Where conversational and agentic search changes how customers get to a decision.
Making search work across three brands, multiple languages, and query behaviour that differs market by market.
Our humble expectations
We're looking for a product leader more than a feature owner. Someone who can find the problems that matter most, for customers and for the business, and make the case for solving them.
You bring proven experience as a Product Manager in Consumer, or on another relevance- or ranking-driven consumer experience.
You demonstrate fluency with search measurement and know how to actually move it.
You show strong product judgment, backed by data literacy and customer insight.
You work backwards from the customer problem, and you can weigh that against the most urgent business problems at the same time, rather than treating it as a side you have to pick.
You think strategically: you can zoom out to where the domain should be in two years, then zoom back in on what we should ship next quarter.
You're comfortable with ambiguity and genuinely flexible. This industry is changing fast, AI most of all, and the plan we write in January won't be the plan in June.
You work deeply with ML and engineering on relevance and ranking, without needing to be an ML expert yourself.
You're curious about what AI actually changes for customers, and you can tell real value from hype.
You build a case and bring people with you: engineering, design, analytics, and local market teams across three brands and many markets.
You do your best work with range: global platform thinking one week, a specific market's reality the next.
Next steps
The position will be filled as soon as we find the right person, so make sure to apply as soon as you realize you really, really want to join us!
Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion
We’re committed to growing and empowering a more inclusive community within our company, industry, and cities. Every CodePath learner engages our platform, whether they are a college CS student in a direct course, a student at a partner university, an alum sharpening their skills, or a working engineer retraining for the AI era. The Senior Product Manager, Learner Platform Experience owns this platform.
CodePath's courses work because they are intensive, industry-vetted, and human. The hard problem is scale. As we grow from tens of thousands of learners toward millions, the quality and effectiveness of the learner experience on the platform has to improve, not dilute.

That demands an AI-First approach: clearly and thoughtfully identifying where AI can accelerate effectiveness, productivity, and scale, and where human connection and touchpoints are essential to maintain motivation, commitment, and progress. Getting that boundary right is the core judgment call of this job, and you will make it over and over.
The ownership lines are clear. Curriculum owns what we teach. The Learning team owns how it is taught, including the live classroom. You own the platform: everything a learner touches when they log in, from the course portal to asynchronous engagement between sessions to the touchpoints that keep them moving. You will collaborate closely with Learning so the platform powers great live delivery, but the platform experience is yours.
Success looks like measurable acceleration in the rate of learning, retention, and engagement, even as the number of students grows by an order of magnitude.
Two things make this role unlike most PM jobs
Learning rate is the scoreboard. Plenty of platforms can deliver content at scale. Almost none can prove their students learn faster because of them. You will be measured on outcomes, retention, and engagement, not feature velocity.
The ceiling is enormous. Every course CodePath delivers, direct or through partners, rides on the platform experience you build. As we scale to an order of magnitude of more students, your decisions compound across every learner we will ever serve.

Jerry .ai is a profitable, Series C, YC-backed tech startup with 5M+ customers and $240M in funding. We’re building the first AI-powered advisor to manage all your physical assets. We started with car insurance in 2019, now we’re expanding into new verticals (e.g. home, motorcycle, RV, boat) and accelerating our growth.

The next chapter is about accelerating our growth — going from 5M to 50M customers by 2030.

The Growth team owns the entire customer sign-up and purchase funnel for our car insurance marketplace, and drives how millions of people discover, evaluate, and become a Jerry customer.
We’re looking for a Senior Product Manager to own the customer journey from first impression through purchase and beyond. This role sits at the heart of our business - you’ll take end-to-end ownership of high-impact funnels that directly move the needle on our north star goal.

This is not a “growth hacking” role or one that prioritizes revenue at the cost of the customer experience and trust — we care about building a durable growth engine by creating a magical customer experience and providing unreasonable hospitality.

You will need to investigate and understand customer needs across different personas, navigate complex backend systems, and translate that complexity into clear, trustworthy, and elegant user experiences.

What you will actually do
Things move quickly here and we just launched 5 big products this year, so there likely won’t be a “typical” day but here are some examples of things you could own:
Own landing pages, signup funnels, app download pages, including simplifying the user flow (insurance shopping is very complex and requires a lot of data inputs from the customer), personalizing the experience by user persona and marketing channel, building trust through designing delightful and helpful communication, copy and UI, etc
Own quote shopping, including improving the display of complex information to our customers without cognitive overload, integrating different insurance carriers (who all model risk and behave differently) into simple user experiences, balancing the needs and goals of our customers and our insurance carrier partners
Integrating other products (e.g., roadside assistance, home insurance, property tax appeals, motorcycle insurance, etc) into our car insurance shopping funnel

Small team: The Growth team has 3 Product Managers (including you) and the surface area is huge, which means you'll have to be scrappy, but also that you'll have lots of scope and ownership.
Fast shipping culture: We run weekly sprints. Products that take 6-12 months to ship elsewhere, we launch in 1-2 months. This means faster learning and faster growth, but also a more demanding environment.

First principles thinker: You’re comfortable breaking ambiguous problems into clear hypotheses before reaching for a solution, as well as working with incomplete information.

Customer-centric: You find customer feedback intrinsically interesting and not some box to check. You care deeply about understanding what drives how they think, feel and behave.

Product Manager - Limbic Access
Limbic builds AI-powered mental healthcare. Our front-door Access product talks to thousands of patients a month across the NHS and major US health systems. Access is past 0→1 in the UK and US: the product exists, customers are live, the model is proven. We're hiring a Product Manager to take it 1→10 in the US, against a growing pipeline of enterprise customers, owning the team's day-to-day product cadence. The job is to ship and ship well.
What You'll Own
You'll own the week-to-week rhythm that turns engineering into shipped product:
Run the team's ceremonies: effective, alignment-creating, always followed up on.
Own roadmap prioritisation. Understand the projects in play, weigh their relative impact, and sequence them. Ground the sequencing in customer signal, and user feedback, usage, and behaviour.
Triage the inbound: bugs, debt, CS asks, scope additions. Separate real issues from noise, route to the right owner, decide what gets iterated when.
Scope and define the work. Write project overviews the team can act on, ensuring the next-highest-value project is always lined up.
Own the incident loop. Triage, root cause, fix, follow-up. Engineers get space to fix; you hold the loop.
Keep the product well instrumented. Mixpanel today and whatever's next. Ensure the team can answer its own questions from the data, and that you can read user behavior out of it.
Protect engineering focus. Hold the line on scope creep from any sources. Check in 1:1 mid-cycle with anyone who's blocked or drifting.

You've shipped product before. Maybe one or two roles in. You want real product management. The kind where you own outcomes, not Jira tickets.
You ship features and projects that move metrics and create outcomes. Not work that's about looking good.
Comfortable with engineers and engineering concepts. You build strong mental models for how products work and apply them in your day-to-day.
You write clearly and quickly. You think clearly from first principles.
You think critically with data. You can pull insights yourself, interrogate how they were generated, and reason about what they actually mean. Not 'I made a decision with data once.'
You never produce AI slop, but you do heavily rely on AI in your day-to-day. You go beyond using AI to write PRDs.
You are 'client safe' - you can represent Limbic to customers professionally.
You can say no to someone and make them feel it's in their best interest.
You build products. You know the difference between a feature that creates repeatable value and a one-off that introduces drag and tech debt.
Healthcare experience is a bonus, but not a requirement. EHR integration and working knowledge of health-data standards (HL7, FHIR) especially.
You won't fit if you need polished process, a heavy spec phase, or a team that loves meetings. We're ahead of our process.
Why This Role
Two things to know.
One. It's a delivery role for now, with a clear set of projects to execute on (but prioritize and sequence effectively). You'll grow into more strategic scope over the next 4-6 months. The immediate brief is to make the engineering team's product cadence quieter and more predictable.
Two. The team is small and load is high. The hire exists because we need to free senior product time for discovery and strategy on a separate product. You might feel the pressure of that. In return: real customers (millions of lives) and the opportunity to iterate the product in a company-defining direction.

Zopa is proud to offer a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and backgrounds leads to better products for our customers and a unique company culture for our people.

Our approach to AI in interviews
At Zopa, AI isn't something we're testing out — it's part of how we work every day. As a proud partner of Jobs 2030 , we're committed to building AI fluency across our workforce, and we expect Zopians to use AI as part of how they do their jobs.
Because of that, we want to be transparent about how we think about AI use during our hiring process.
Behavioural and competency-based interviews : please don't use AI . These conversations are designed to understand you — your experiences, your judgment, and how you've approached real situations. An AI-generated answer can't tell us that. What it can do is get in the way of us finding out whether we're the right fit for each other.
Technical interviews: it depends on the role. Some technical stages actively welcome AI use, others don't. Your Talent Partner will let you know what's expected at each stage. Where AI is part of the assessment, we'll be interested not just in the outcome, but in how you used it – the tools you chose, your reasoning, and the decisions you made along the way.

À propos du rôle
Le mobile est l'un de nos domaines stratégiquement les plus importants - il devient la manière dont les employés accèdent partout aux outils et au support dont ils ont besoin, bien au-delà du bureau.

Nous recherchons un Chef de Produit qui gère l'activité Mobile de bout en bout : stimuler l'adoption chez les clients, garder une vue complète du pipeline de ventes et des engagements de preuve de valeur, débloquer les affaires, s'assurer que le produit est correctement implémenté et adopté de manière constante une fois en production, et aligner les ventes, le conseil en solutions, les services professionnels, le marketing et l'ingénierie autour d'un plan unique.
Vous serez responsable de la feuille de route Mobile au sens large - pas seulement du produit, mais aussi de la stratégie d'adoption, des priorités de mise sur le marché, de l'adaptation des prix et des offres si nécessaire, ainsi que de la relation quotidienne avec notre organisation commerciale. Une fois ce modèle fonctionnel pour le Mobile, vous l'étendrez à d'autres domaines, en commençant par notre offre d'infrastructure de bureau virtuel (VDI).
Un rôle de chef de produit axé sur le business
Ce n'est pas un rôle de chef de produit plateforme. Il ne s'agit pas de gérer un backlog ou des spécifications - votre temps sera consacré aux clients, à l'organisation commerciale et au terrain, et vous serez évalué sur l'impact commercial : adoption du Mobile et croissance du revenu récurrent annuel (ARR). Vous n'aurez pas de quota de vente, mais vous serez responsable du résultat. Si ce type de gestion de produit vous plaît, continuez votre lecture.
Pourquoi ce rôle, et pourquoi il est difficile
Ce rôle est directement responsable de l'adoption du Mobile et de son impact sur l'ARR, avec une exposition réelle sur le terrain et auprès des clients, et une vision claire de ce à quoi ressemble le "bon" résultat. Si vous souhaitez construire une activité au sein d'une scale-up, c'est l'opportunité.
C'est aussi un rôle véritablement challengeant. Il n'existe pas encore de guides - c'est notre première embauche de ce type. Vous serez le lien entre notre organisation commerciale et nos équipes produit et ingénierie, et vous les rassemblerez autour d'un plan unique pour le Mobile.
Ce que vous ferez
* Gérer la feuille de route Mobile et la dynamique d'adoption, puis l'étendre au VDI
* Maintenir une vue à 360° du pipeline et des engagements de preuve de valeur (POV), et savoir ce qui bloque chaque opportunité
* Rester impliqué après la vente - s'assurer que Mobile est correctement implémenté et adopté de manière constante par les clients, pas seulement vendu
* Maintenir une intelligence client approfondie : comment les clients utilisent réellement le produit, ce qu'ils ont déployé, et où leur stratégie informatique se dirige
* S'intégrer à l'organisation commerciale (affaires, revues commerciales trimestrielles, réunions clients) et devenir une personne que les commerciaux veulent activement avoir dans la salle
* Aligner les ventes, le conseil en solutions, les services professionnels, le marketing et l'ingénierie autour d'un plan communiqué unique
* Transformer les apprentissages du terrain en une liste priorisée de blocages et de priorités produit
* Jouer un rôle de premier plan dans l'adaptation des prix et des offres lorsque nécessaire, en collaboration avec le marketing produit et les ventes
* Être évalué sur l'adoption du Mobile et la croissance de l'ARR

Ce que nous recherchons

* Utilisation quotidienne crédible d'outils d'IA
* Plus de 5 ans d'expérience pertinente, incluant au moins une période de plus de 2 ans où votre impact s'est accru
* Épanoui dans un environnement de scale-up rapide où les priorités changent et la structure est encore en construction
* Basé à Lausanne ou prêt à s'y relocaliser ; capable de voyager à l'international
Atouts (non obligatoires)

Informations supplémentaires
Nous sommes les pionniers et éclaireurs d'une catégorie de marché IT mondiale (DEX) qui façonne l'avenir du travail dans le monde, offrant aux équipes IT de nos clients une visibilité numérique totale sur leur entreprise.
